prompt: What is the likely consequence if the editor posts the approved PDF but forgets to update the public changelog?
promptZh: 若編輯放上核准版 PDF，卻忘了更新公開變更紀錄，最可能有什麼後果？

options.text: The original public link would begin opening revision 5.
options.zh: 原公開連結會開始開啟第 5 版。
options.whyZh: 是否更新公開紀錄不會決定連結指向哪個 PDF。

options.text: Readers can get the approved guide but miss the notice about the new operator instruction.
options.zh: 讀者可取得核准版，但可能沒看到新增操作指示的通知。
options.whyZh: 連結替換和更新紀錄是兩件事；核准稿可下載，但應公開的操作變更沒有列出。

options.text: Trainers would have to request a public copy of the clearer drawing alone.
options.zh: 講師必須單獨索取公開的新版插圖。
options.whyZh: 核准稿仍有插圖；不用另外索取。

options.text: The distributor would automatically get an email attachment.
options.zh: 經銷商會自動收到電子郵件附件。
options.whyZh: 規則不以附件發送新版，漏寫公開紀錄不會啟動郵件。

explanationZh: 連結替換和更新紀錄是兩件事；核准稿可下載，但應公開的操作變更沒有列出。
evidence: Replace the PDF behind the link when approving an update; do not email the updated PDF itself to distributors. / In the public changelog, list only changes that alter what an operator must do. / The wait is new.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Replace the PDF behind the link when approving an update; do not email the updated PDF itself to distributors.
In the public changelog, list only changes that alter what an operator must do.

vocabulary.note: alter what an operator must do 指改變必要的作業方式。
